lines.beaver: 새로 온 민수 씨 어때요? 장점이 뭐예요?
lines.beaver_en: How's Minsu, the new guy? What are his strengths?
lines.beaver_roman: saero on minsu ssi eottaeyo? jangjeomi mwoyeyo?
lines.learner: 민수 씨는 정말 성실해요. 그게 제일 큰 장점이에요.
lines.en: Minsu is really diligent. That's his biggest strength.
lines.roman: minsu ssineun jeongmal seongsilhaeyo. geuge jeil keun jangjeomieyo.

lines.learner: 좀 내성적이라서 회의 때 말을 잘 안 해요.
lines.en: He's a bit introverted, so he rarely talks in meetings.
lines.roman: jom naeseongjeogiraseo hoeui ttae mareul jal an haeyo.

lines.en: He's quiet but warm. He sincerely helps coworkers.

lines.learner: 네, 인심이 좋아서 간식도 자주 나눠 줘요.
lines.en: Yes, he's generous and often shares snacks.
lines.roman: ne, insimi joaseo gansikdo jaju nanwo jwoyo.

lines.learner: 컴퓨터는 천재처럼 잘해요. 그런데 모르는 척도 해요.
lines.en: He's like a genius with computers. But he also pretends not to know.
lines.roman: keompyuteoneun cheonjaecheoreom jalhaeyo. geureonde moreuneun cheokdo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Why does he pretend not to know?
lines.learner: 잘난 척을 싫어해서 바보 같은 척도 해요.
lines.en: He hates showing off, so he even acts like a fool.
lines.roman: jallan cheogeul sireohaeseo babo gateun cheokdo haeyo.

lines.learner: 다들 좋게 봐요. 이미지가 아주 좋아요.
lines.en: Everyone sees him well. His image is very good.
lines.roman: dadeul joke bwayo. imijiga aju joayo.

lines.beaver_en: How would you sum up Minsu in a word?
lines.en: He has pros and cons, but he's a diligent, good coworker.

lines.beaver_en: Then how can we help him?
lines.learner: 회의 때 먼저 의견을 물어봐 주면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: It'd be good to ask his opinion first in meetings.
lines.roman: hoeui ttae meonjeo uigyeoneul mureobwa jumyeon jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 오늘 점심에 민수 씨도 같이 불러요.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Let's invite Minsu to lunch today.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. oneul jeomsime minsu ssido gachi bulleoyo.
lines.learner: 좋아요! 제가 지금 가서 말해 볼게요.
lines.en: Great! I'll go tell him now.
lines.roman: joayo! jega jigeum gaseo malhae bolgeyo.
